summary: The explicit source-only profile joins three fixed private FIFO/gzip phases to the existing measurement loop, authenticated one-use handshake, per-use capacity/read-drift/affinity/actor checks, strict shared semantic parser and canonical result finalization. The tracer opens its fixed named FIFO; the apparatus inherits no trace output FD into the subject and adds no shell/compressor actor. Held directory/artifact capabilities, fresh complete namespace census and prior-artifact hashes cover all partial outputs and manifest. Stored file sizes across phases and manifest are capped at8MiB; captured and decoded bytes each share32MiB, with conservative saturation refusal. These are stored-byte limits, not an8MiB physical-allocation guarantee. Future per-line and conservative retained-object refusal avoid unchecked Unicode/event amplification; original aggregate sampled RSS remains necessary. Operation uses original WORK and postterminal retention uses original TOTAL without renewal. First cause and independent sibling/reporting failures remain; unknown settlement cannot make a successful manifest, and close failure after a manifest is failed-or-unknown. Complete normal projections preserve sorted-PID/per-PID serial ordering and the same fork/cwd/FD/read/lifetime engine; per-PID hashes are derived projections, while aborted tails remain physical encoded bytes with no read-closure claim. Inert controls exercise real capture, handshake, parser, bounds/census, control-retirement and full apparatus finalization using bounded fake process/kernel adapters. The current CLI refuses prospective selection without measured source context before a launch or slot claim. Current raw8MiB profiles, maximum ordinal4 and original failed/unknown holds remain unchanged. No actual tracer/client/native/App qualification occurs. Future runtime selection still requires independently reconciled exact tracer/interpreter/zlib and library source closure, bootstrap inventory/capacity, finite clocks, representation contract and explicit admission. Complete-stream fit, no-birth safety, runtime observational equivalence and physical resource conformance remain unproved; retained incomplete gzip fit is not acceptance.
title: Prospective lossless PROC capture joins the finite apparatus but grants no runtime admission
